scope: Fixed L=16 torus; three complex components in the six-real convention; hash-pinned A1 production covariance and Class-II coefficients; rho_regularizer=1e-12; eta_shell=0; unit sharp common real-even regulator; and the A10-A13 strict dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The shifted-Gaussian identity, exact fast-phase principal-symbol source-slot doubling, its asymptotic transfer to the registered carrier, the precisely scoped local Bellman obstruction, mixed Hardy lemma, potential coercivity, and one-shell frozen-source crossover are analytic. The K=65536 values are independently reproduced finite calculations, not formal interval arithmetic.

theorem.joint_completion: For q=p theta, R_q=(I+qT)^-1, and mu_q=-qR_q ell, the joint conditional transform is the exact det_2/noncentral constant plus expectation of C_j+U under N(mu_q,R_q).
theorem.source_doubling: In the exact same-corner fast-phase principal-symbol fixture, the coefficient-slot first variation equals the frozen derivative-slot first variation, so ell_joint=2 ell_frozen and the source square gains factor four. Envelope-derivative, trace, and potential terms are lower order on the registered degree-K carrier, so the factor four is an asymptotic carrier statement rather than an unqualified finite-K shell identity.
theorem.terminal_past_split: The A13 K=65536 terminal amplification is (D/B)^3=919.8715735886835; C_rel=0.9160527282652334 corresponds to the terminal norm while c_past=0.0009958485016462115 corresponds to the conditional past norm.
theorem.local_bellman_nogo: The coefficient-one potential-increment conditional estimate and every finite bank of local q/quartic/sextic polynomial terms with bounded coefficients and cutoff-summable positive replenishments and scalar transfer errors fail because the asymptotic 4 C_rel=3.6642109130609337 exceeds gamma/(3p) for every p>=1 while potential and trace variations are lower order at A^2/N^2->0.
theorem.mixed_hardy: For normalized Haar measure, g=P_<0 f obeys ||g||_4^8 <= (64/9)||f||_2^2||f||_6^6, by the nonpositive product projection, real-spectrum half-energy, the sharp L3 Riesz norm 2/sqrt(3), and interpolation.
theorem.frozen_cm_sextic: Every finite-cutoff field and shell obey p^2/2 <ell,(I+pT)^-1ell> <= theta H_A(x)+p^2 beta_op^2/(16 c_sym theta)||x||_6^6.
theorem.surviving_reduction: Full positive closure is reduced to one adapted-control inequality with epsilon_6<gamma/12=0.135 and epsilon_v<1/(2p), spending Cameron-Martin energy once across all scales and producing no new interaction counterterm.
theorem.one_use_equivalence: For G_J=V_J^ren+epsilon_6||phi||_6^6, the uniform one-use lower bound with control coefficient epsilon_v is exactly equivalent by Boue-Dupuis to sup_J E exp[-G_J/(2 epsilon_v)]<infinity. At epsilon_v=0.45 this is q=10/9>1.1, so BD, entropy, Follmer, or HJB alone would be circular.
theorem.timewise_young_nogo: For V(x)=(x^4-3x^2)/2 the exact Doob integrand is g_t(x)=2x^3+(3-6t)x. A triangular zero-endpoint loop has control cost 4A^2 and fixed terminal sixth moment 15, while E integral g_t(W_t+h_A)^2 dt=21/2+(78/5)A^2+6A^4+(4/7)A^6 and the signed action change is zero. Therefore no coefficient-blind endpoint-only enclosure by terminal L6 plus Cameron-Martin energy can hold uniformly; Class-II-specific signed tensor estimates are not excluded.
theorem.nonfrozen_schatten_decomposition: In whitened variables 2V_J^ren=delta_gamma b_J and Db_J=T_X+K_X, where T_X>=0 and both T_X,K_X have cutoff-uniform deterministic Schatten-two bounds from the q^-4 production symbol. This does not imply a lower bound on det_2(I+tDb_J).
theorem.coefficient_curl: For x=u e1, Omega_x(e1,e3)=4u q_u[b+c(1-q_u)]e3 is nonzero for u!=0, so B is not an exact coefficient one-form and the nonfrozen feedback cannot be absorbed into the positive determinant factor.
theorem.conditional_cf_bound: If R=t(I+tT_X)^-1K_X has operator norm at most rho<1 and the direct Ramer map is an orientation-preserving Gaussian C1 diffeomorphism, determinant factorization gives a cutoff-uniform Carleman-Fredholm bound with t^2||T||_2^2/2+c_rho||R||_2^2+t||T||_2||R||_2. These are additional hypotheses, not consequences of Schatten-two control.
theorem.one_shot_ramer_nogo: Because 2V=delta_gamma b, q=10/9 uses t=q/2=5/9. Two independent 30-real-mode production calculations find a negative real Db eigenvalue near -0.147586951 and a determinant sign change near amplitude 3.49230586, with the floor inactive. The one-shot u=t b global Ramer diffeomorphism/positive-determinant architecture is false; the Nelson moment itself is not refuted.
theorem.predictable_triangular_boundary: For frozen full positive-square shells with block-diagonal T>=0 and strictly block-lower-triangular predictable feedback K, det_2(I+t(T+K)) equals the product of the positive block determinants. This maximal current determinant theorem does not close A11 true increments after subtracting their past squares.
